title: AI for Sales Teaching Expert
description:
Description
Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen ) is an international educational platform that helps business professionals and organizations navigate AI-driven transformation. We create practical programs that help teams apply AI tools to real business workflows, make informed decisions, and lead organizational change.
We are looking for a senior AI for Sales Teaching Expert with direct professional experience in the insurance or insurance-brokerage industry, hands-on knowledge of AI applications for sales, and a strong understanding of the Latin American business environment. Professional experience in Chile is strongly preferred.
You will design and deliver live virtual sessions for sales teams and sales managers, focusing on practical applications of AI across the sales cycle. Topics will include lead qualification, personalized outreach, sales forecasting, CRM and workflow automation, and AI-assisted client communication.
Your role will be to turn these topics into practical and relevant learning experiences, adapt examples and case studies to the insurance and brokerage context, guide participants through real sales scenarios, evaluate their progress, and provide constructive feedback. You will also collaborate with Customer Success and Program teams to ensure that the content supports the client’s business goals.
What you will do

• Design and deliver live virtual sessions on practical AI applications for sales, including lead qualification, personalized outreach, sales forecasting, and AI-assisted client communication.

• Adapt the learning content to insurance and brokerage sales cycles, customer relationships, and regional business practices.

• Demonstrate practical AI-supported sales workflows through relevant tools, exercises, and real-world case studies.

• Provide examples and use cases relevant to insurance sales teams in Latin America.

• Evaluate participant progress and provide clear, constructive feedback.

• Collaborate with Customer Success and Program teams to align the learning experience with client goals.

• Keep the program current with AI tools and trends relevant to sales enablement.

Requirements
Must Have

• Professional experience in the insurance or insurance brokerage industry.

• Professional experience working in Latin America; experience in Chile is strongly preferred.

• Proven experience teaching, training, facilitating, or mentoring sales professionals.

• Strong knowledge of practical AI applications and tools relevant to sales workflows.

• Ability to explain and demonstrate how AI can support lead qualification, personalized outreach, sales forecasting, and client communication.

• Native-level Spanish and professional working proficiency in English.

• Confidence delivering live virtual instruction to groups.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and participant-feedback skills.

Nice to Have

• Experience delivering corporate or B2B training programs.

• Direct experience in insurance sales or broker relationship management.

• Experience adapting training materials to a specific client, market, or sales process.

• Hands-on familiarity with ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or comparable AI platforms in a sales context.

• Current knowledge of AI-supported sales enablement practices and tools.

• Professional experience in Chile or familiarity with the Chilean insurance market.

What we can offer you

• A remote, part-time expert engagement with Nebius Academy.

• The opportunity to help corporate sales teams apply AI to real insurance and brokerage workflows.

• Live, cohort-based delivery with flexible scheduling.

• Collaboration with Customer Success and Program teams.

• An hourly rate of up to USD 90, depending on the final agreement.

• A project scope currently indicated as 10 hours, subject to final confirmation.

title: Director, PDM Planning & Operations
description:
Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.

The Impact You Will Make

Partner Data Manager (PDM) is Risepoint's centralized database for partner and program information. It is also the mechanism through which Partner Support updates and distributes partner-facing content and resources organization-wide, giving teams one source of truth and helping ensure consistent messaging across Risepoint and with prospective and current students.
As Risepoint's business grows more dependent on PDM, this role ensures PDM evolves deliberately: anticipating business needs, prioritizing the right improvements (including user experience), and powering the transformation initiatives the business has prioritized. You will lead the business direction and roadmap for PDM, translating broader business priorities and the needs of Partner Support, Finance, Marketing, and other teams into a clear, prioritized roadmap. You'll partner closely with Business Technology's Product Owner, who leads technical delivery, while you own the business case, priorities, and the team that keeps PDM running reliably day to day.
How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life
What You Will Do

• Serve as the business owner for PDM, shaping its multi-year vision and translating Risepoint’s broader business and transformation priorities into a clear roadmap, priorities, and business requirements.

• Represent the business voice in roadmap trade-off decisions when partnering with Business Technology.

• Build and maintain a structured intake and prioritization process for enhancement requests, balancing transformation-critical work, UX improvements, compliance/audit needs, and operational fixes.

• Develop business cases and value justifications (cost, risk, efficiency, user experience) for proposed PDM investments.

• Identify UX friction points and data/functionality gaps across PDM users and champion improvements through the roadmap

• Serve as the primary point of accountability for PDM within Partner Support, representing its capabilities, constraints, and roadmap to leadership.

• Act as liaison to Business Technology on all PDM-related initiatives, escalating and resolving cross-functional roadblocks.

• Maintain a cross-functional view of how PDM connects to adjacent systems and processes, anticipating ripple effects of a given change rather than evaluating each request in isolation.

• Own post-release follow-through - checking that changes landed as intended, gathering feedback from affected teams, and feeding lessons learned back into how future changes are scoped and rolled out.
What Success Looks Like

• A prioritized, business-aligned PDM roadmap is in place and jointly owned with Business Technology's Product Owner.

• Enhancement requests move through a clear intake and prioritization process

• Key UX pain points and data/functionality gaps for PDM users have been identified and are being actively addressed.

• Major PDM releases land with minimal disruption because affected teams were identified, informed, and prepared in advance.

title: Controller
description:
Metabase is the easiest way for people to get insights from their data, from tiny startups who get up and running quickly to major corporations with tens of thousands of users. That's why people love us.
We bring data tools with the elegance and simplicity of consumer products to the crufty world of enterprise business intelligence. We provide an opinionated open source starting point for how companies should measure, analyze and share their data, which is used by tens of thousands of companies.
Metabase 's BizOps & Finance team builds the systems keeping the company running smoothly behind the scenes. We cover a wide range of areas - finance and accounting, sales operations, legal operations, compliance, and account management - but we treat them all as flavors of operations. Whatever the task, we take a systems-driven approach - design it, build it, and run it (ideally, automatically). Our goal is to free the rest of the company to focus on building great software.
We're hiring an experienced Controller to own accounting and financial operations at Metabase . It's a broad startup controller role: you'll own core accounting and audit, along with tax, payments, and expense management. Today we run as a small, high-leverage team that delivers much of this through external firms - accountants and tax professionals - so your initial focus will be on managing those partners. Over time, there's scope to bring accounting in-house.
This is a role for someone who's an expert in their domain but comfortable in a fluid, ambiguous environment - and energized by building out our financial operations as well as running them.
Responsibilities

• General ledger & close - manage and review the month-end close (run today through external accountants); investigate and resolve discrepancies

• Audit - own the external auditor relationship; coordinate information requests internally; investigate and resolve issues that surface

• Tax - manage external tax accountants; handle direct execution like new-state registrations and payments

• Accounts payable & expenses - run the payment cycle; own and troubleshoot the corporate card / expense system

• Over time - lead implementation of new systems (ERP, rev rec, payments); potentially build an in-house close process

About You

• Seasoned accountant with an active CPA

• Expertise with US GAAP, SaaS revenue recognition, stock based compensation, multi-entity / international accounting

• Owned full-cycle month end close / quarter end close processes and managed audits end-to-end

• Prior experience in a startup and / or big 4 audit a plus

• Undergraduate qualification in accounting, finance, or a rigorous quantitative field

• Strong investigative skills - you spot when something is off and can reconstruct what happened

• High bar for accuracy, with exacting attention to detail and little tolerance for errors

• Strong organizational skills - you can keep multiple streams of work running in parallel

• Low ego attitude - you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in

• Based in the US

Compensation
The US base salary range for this role is $125K-$200K annually , plus equity and benefits.
Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors.

description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Factory is hiring a field partner sales leader to drive US federal revenue with the capture, account, and delivery leaders of the federal systems integrators (the primes and mid-tier FSIs), the government cloud providers (AWS GovCloud, Microsoft Azure Government, Google Public Sector), federal-focused software partners, and the reseller channel (Carahsoft as distributor plus the second-tier resellers who hold the contract vehicles). This role supports federal sales and is focused on US civilian, defense, and intelligence agencies and the partners that serve them. The leader will align with partner capture and account teams, build partner relationships at the program and agency level that produce joint pipeline, and turn early-stage partnerships into repeatable co-sell and resale.

How This Motion Builds

These are early-stage motions and partnerships, and federal adds contract vehicles, compliance gates, and a fiscal-year clock. The sequence matters:

- Make the connections. Get to the right capture leads, account executives, and practice leaders inside the primes, government clouds, software partners, and reseller channel; earn a seat in their programs.

- Win lighthouses. Land a small number of joint, referenceable wins (a pilot on an agency modernization program, an FSI using Factory in its own delivery) that prove the co-sell works in federal.

- Quantify the benefit. Instrument and document the mission outcome and the partner value (modernization acceleration, legacy code migrated, cloud consumption, contract value) so the story is credible and repeatable.

- Earn seller trust. Show partner capture and account teams that Factory helps them win and deliver programs, so co-sell becomes something they ask for.

- Then scale. Once the motion is proven, expand it through the distributor and second-tier reseller network, contract vehicles, field marketing, enablement, and formal partner programs.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Own federal partner revenue. Drive partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and reseller-transacted pipeline and bookings across FSIs, government clouds, software partners, and the reseller channel.

- Build capture-level relationships. Develop trusted relationships with FSI capture leads, account executives, and delivery and practice leaders, not just alliance managers, and get into joint program and agency account planning.

- Land the modernization wedge. Work with FSI, software, and cloud field teams to identify agency programs where Factory accelerates legacy modernization and cloud migration, and co-sell those opportunities to close; sell to the integrators for their own delivery work as a near-term path.

- Run the co-sell in the field. Agency and program planning, joint calls, solution narratives, teaming, deal registration, and triangulated deals (Factory + government cloud + FSI + software partner + reseller on the same program).

- Work the channel. Run the Carahsoft relationship day to day, recruit and enable second-tier resellers, route deals through the right contract vehicles (GSA MAS, NASA SEWP, CIO-SP, agency BPAs) and marketplaces, and keep quoting, pricing, and deal registration moving.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
About the company Impare:
Imparé , a Silicon Valley-based startup and a subsidiary of Jaffer Business Systems (JBS) , marks JBS's first international investment and a significant step toward advancing Pakistan's presence in the global semiconductor industry. With this milestone, JBS has positioned itself at the forefront of chip verification services in the country. The company is building a verification hub in Pakistan, designed to support leading semiconductor firms worldwide while nurturing local engineering talent. Through world-class training and real-world project exposure, Imparé empowers Pakistani engineers to collaborate with global technology leaders - bridging innovation, expertise, and opportunity across borders.
Role Overview
Identify, research, qualify, and prioritize potential customers matching Impare's ideal customer profile. Maintain accurate CRM records and coordinate timely follow-up after founder-led workshops and webinars. This is a research and coordination role; outreach, pitching, and substantive prospect conversations are handled by the Founder/CEO.
Job Responsibilities

• Identify 40-60 relevant LinkedIn prospects per month, focusing on chip, SoC, and chiplet design and verification leaders at fabless AI infrastructure silicon companies.

• Quality and rank leads based on funding status and proximity to a named tapeout date.

• Record and update lead source, company, role, technical interest, relationship strength, last interaction, and next action in the CRM.

• Log, score, and prepare follow-up details for all workshop and webinar registrants and attendees within 48 hours.

• Pre-qualify leads before sharing them with the Founder/CEO, aiming for at least 80% to generate a reply or conversation.

• Monitor changes in prospect roles, companies, and engagement, and flag renewed interest for timely follow-up.

• Provide monthly insights on the prospect profiles, company types, and event topics generating the strongest leads.

Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or Engineering is required. Certifications in sales enablement, CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), or account management are preferred.
Experience
5-8 years of relevant experience in sales development, research, recruiting, or lead qualification is preferred.
﻿Experience in sales development, research, recruiting, or a similar role involving prospect identification and qualification. Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar tools and strong research judgment and CRM discipline are important. Semiconductor industry knowledge is helpful but not essential.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
Founded in 1999, WorldWinner develops and operates competitive games of skill with real cash prizes under the WorldWinner consumer brand and in partnership with leading Sports Gaming Entertainment company FanDuel under the FanDuel Faceoff name.
WorldWinner is the most recognized and trusted skill games technology platform and brand for players who want to Play to Win. We bring games to the world that inspire people to play for more. With over 20 challenging games where the outcome is dependent on player skills versus chance across a content library spanning classic card games to casual favorites to retro arcade games, WorldWinner has something for every gamer. Backed by Platinum Equity and strategic investors, we are building the next phase of our platform on mobile and beyond.
Supporting the SVP of Engineering, you’ll own how work flows into WorldWinner ’s central services, DevOps and data teams in a fintech-grade, real-money gaming environment. You’ll run intake and triage, keep one view of everything in flight, report clearly on what shipped and why, and automate the status-chasing out of the process. You'll also lead a small team of contract engineers covering central services and data. It’s ideal for an engineer who’d rather make the whole system run well than build one more feature. This is a contract role.
What You'll Do

• Run intake and triage for central services, DevOps and data. Decide what each request is, who it goes to, and when it’s back

• Keep one view of what's in flight across teams, so parallel work doesn't collide or spoil someone else's results

• Report what shipped, what's rolling out and what's stuck, and write the summary that explains why we chose what we chose

• Notice when work stops moving, and do something about it

• Lead a small team of contract engineers in central services and data. Set priorities, run 1:1s and give us a straight read on how they're doing

• Automate the connective tissue. Some of our systems already talk to each other and we want a lot more of it. Script against their APIs so status moves on its own instead of being chased

• Build the dashboards we don't have. One place showing the health and status of our whole landscape: the apps, the infrastructure, the data, and what's shipping. Pulled together from wherever it actually lives. That's an ambition, not a spec

• Use AI properly. We use it heavily across engineering, and expect you to as well

• Run the delivery basics: planning, commitments, retrospectives, and a clear picture of who owns what in a release

What You'll Need

• You've written and shipped software professionally, then moved toward programs and delivery. We care that you can read code, write scripts and talk to engineers as a peer - not which languages you used

• You automate your own work - calling APIs, wiring tools together, building the report rather than asking for it

• You use AI tools seriously, and have a view on where they help and where they don't

• You've owned delivery or release reporting for a team that ships regularly

• You've led engineers before, even a small group. We're not asking for a career manager, we're asking for someone people will follow

• Good judgment about what's urgent and what's only loud

• Clear writing. Most of this job happens in writing

• Calm under pressure, and the kind of presence that makes people bring you problems early

Nice to Have But Not Necessary

• Live-service, real-money or regulated-product experience

• Mobile release management - Apple App Store, Google Play

• Administering Jira or Confluence

• Incident response and on-call practice

• AWS or another cloud provider

A Note on Applying
If you can do most of this, we'd like to hear from you. We'd rather talk to someone strong in four of these areas than someone who ticks every box.

title: Senior Data Reporting Professional
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Data & Reporting Professional supports the Michigan Integrated Long-Term Services and Supports (MI LTSS) program through advanced analytics, operational reporting, performance monitoring, regulatory compliance reporting, and strategic data management. You will transform complex clinical, operational, quality, and financial data into actionable insights that support program oversight, state contract compliance, quality improvement initiatives, and executive decision-making. Your work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. You will work independently, exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments, and begin to influence departmental strategy. The Senior Data & Reporting Professional partners closely with LTSS Care Management, Utilization Management, Quality, Finance, Compliance, Provider Operations, and Market Leadership to monitor program performance, identify operational opportunities, and support achievement of LTSS program requirements.

• Develop and maintain operational, clinical, quality, compliance, and executive dashboards supporting the MI LTSS program.

• Integrate and validate data from multiple systems, including care management platforms, quality monitoring tools, provider networks, claims data, assessment systems, and regulatory reporting sources.

• Create recurring and ad hoc reports supporting operational performance, regulatory compliance, quality improvement initiatives, and strategic program planning.

• Monitor LTSS performance indicators including Health Risk Assessments, InterRAI assessments, Nursing Facility Level of Care Determination (NFLOCD) completion, Person-Centered Service Plans, Integrated Care Team (ICT) participation, HCBS utilization, care management productivity, and state quality measures.

• Support ongoing monitoring of LTSS contractual requirements through development of compliance and performance reporting tools.

• Partner with LTSS leadership to identify emerging trends, operational risks, barriers to performance, and opportunities for process improvement.

• Develop executive summaries and presentations communicating program performance and strategic recommendations.

• Support state audits, readiness reviews, corrective action plans, and regulatory inquiries through data analysis and reporting.

• Serve as a subject matter expert regarding LTSS operational reporting, analytics, and performance monitoring.

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in business Analytics, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Information Systems, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.

• Five (5) or more years of healthcare analytics, reporting, managed care, population health, Medicaid, or related healthcare experience.

• Experience working with large, complex healthcare and operational datasets.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including dashboard development, data modeling, and advanced reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree in healthcare, business, analytics, or public health discipline.

• Experience supporting LTSS, HCBS Waiver, Medicaid, D-SNP, HIDE, FIDE, or integrated care programs.

• Advanced SQL, SAS, Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, or business intelligence tool experience.

title: Sr Architect, Professional Services
description:
Job Description:
We are Omnissa !  

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from anywhere experiences. We integrate industry-leading solutions -including Unified Endpoint Management, Windows Modern Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance- into a seamless, autonomous workspace that adapts to how people work. Our platform boosts employee engagement while optimizing IT operations, security, and cost.

Guided by our Core Values- Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value -we’re growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact. If you're passionate about shaping the future of work, we’d love to hear from you.
What is the opportunity?

At Omnissa , we are committed to maintaining a fair, consistent, and secure hiring process for all candidates. As part of this approach, we use standard interview and verification practices designed to ensure alignment and protect both candidates and the organization. These practices are applied thoughtfully and with respect for candidate privacy.

As a Professional Services Senior Architect, you will be responsible for leading the implementation and championing the adoption of solutions purchased by our most important and largest customers daily. You will gather and analyze customer requirements to create an architectural design consisting of compute infrastructure planning (private and public cloud), recommending and planning configurations, validating deployment, enhancing operations strategy, and increasing user adoption. You will serve as a trusted advisor to our customers, developing an intimate knowledge of their business and strategic goals and use your in-depth knowledge of the Omnissa Workspace ONE Platform to work with customers on building successful implementation and adoption roadmaps and driving the vision to completion.

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

title: Member of Scientific Staff, Protein Production
description: LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time The opportunity We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders. This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team. The role You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you. On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC. description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW) offers a wide variety of opportunities to college students across the country. Unpaid research, communications, and government affairs internships are available on a year-round basis and can vary in length from a semester to a few weeks in duration. Interns can choose to work part-time or full-time, as hours of work are extremely flexible. Our daily work with Capitol Hill and the White House, as well as government agencies and other nonprofit organizations, provides a close and invaluable look at how Washington works. Since CAGW maintains a small staff, interns gain hands-on experience in all aspects of CAGW’s activities. Many projects involve working closely with staff members, while others require a great deal of independence. Interns are considered important members of our staff and actively participate in staff meetings and other events. While interns will also be required to perform clerical duties from time to time, much of the work will be substantive.
 
Research Internship
Assist in formulating policy papers and collect data for original investigative studies. Research and write for CAGW’s annual publications, which include the Congressional Pig Book, Prime Cuts, Government WasteWatch eNews, and special projects, including issue briefs, and policy papers. Interns will have the opportunity to initiate projects. Research internships are also available in specific areas, including healthcare and science, technology and telecommunications, federal regulations and taxation.

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. title: Sr. Internal Auditor
description:

• Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling sensitive audit information.

• Perform additional duties as assigned.

What Makes This Role a Senior Opportunity

• Involvement in quality improvement initiatives and system enhancement discussions with leadership and IT

• Opportunity to influence audit practices and support multiple departments through shared audit resources.

What You Bring
Experience & Education

• Preferred Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

• Minimum 2 years of experience in claims processing, claims auditing, or claims data analysis (Dental PPO or DHMO environment strongly preferred)

•
1+ year of internal audit experience , preferably within a dental or healthcare setting

Skills & Knowledge

• Strong understanding of dental claims processing and audit methodologies

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel

• Strong analytical, reporting, and trend‑analysis skills

• Excellent attention to detail and comfort working with complex data

• Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to promote teamwork across departments

Why Liberty Dental Plan
At Liberty, we are committed to improving lives by expanding access to quality dental care. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, integrity, and accountability-and our People Philosophy centers on empowering employees to thrive while making a meaningful difference for the members and communities we serve.

This is a remote position, but candidates must live in or near Dallas, TX, or Anchorage, AK, or be willing to relocate if offered a permanent position.

The objective is to facilitate a smooth transition to a civilian career in Cybersecurity. • Knowledgeable in firewalls, malware protection, and IPS

• Knowledgeable with encryption technologies (e.g., IPSec, SSL)

• Knowledgeable with home office environments and Internet connectivity to enable remote work from home

title: Google Ads Account Manager
description:
This role is responsible for the day to day media buying, optimization, and strategy of our clients’ Google Ads accounts. The core parts of the role will entail building an understanding of the clients’ businesses on an in-depth level, knowing the ebbs and flows of their ad accounts backward and forwards, and creating & executing comprehensive media strategies to reach client goals. This person will be our eyes on the ground for feedback on creative, messaging audiences, and general client flows with conversion rates. This creates a very dynamic role for the Rubato Google Ads Manager.
Day to Day:

• Is married to the data looking at trendlines across every relevant event and metric on every account.

• Doesn’t wait for performance to show up or not show up in ROAS, but rather identifies early indicators of success or failure and reacts accordingly.

• Doesn't just recognize a problem, but then forms a hypothesis why and presents possible solutions.

• Works very closely with our Head of Media, Creative Director and Client Growth Director to make sure all the data “on the ground” is communicated to other pertinent areas of Rubato for well executed client calls, building out Rubato’s 3 levels of client media plans (12-mo. Growth Plan, Quarterly Plan, 30-day Plan), new creative & messaging sets needed, etc…

• Is involved in the overall media strategy, communicating new ideas and areas of possible growth to the media team lead.

• Stays in the loop on the client Slack workspaces to ensure nothing falls through the cracks and is aware of any upcoming promos, events, etc. that would have an impact on media strategy.

• Sets up all campaigns in Google Ads Platform and uses Editor for speed.

• Constantly looks for ways to improve the accounts on a granular level and ensures we are conforming to best practices or core strategies. Our creative team will have all creatives ready to go in mock campaigns. This person pulls in the creatives & messaging to test across audiences they have developed and setup.

• Will be part of a cross-functional team, working closely with both our media team and client growth team to deliver the best results for our clients

• Knows Google Ads’ interfaces inside & out

• Hyper data-focused and easily able to understand the mathematics on main media metrics (CTR, CR, CPM, ROAS, any comparison percentages etc.)

• Understands the importance of looking at data on a trendline

• Able to look at data on the media/creative level and understand what is going well, what is not going well, and where to focus efforts for improvement

• Easily navigate, manipulate & analyze data in Excel or Google Sheets

• Able to think about marketing for our clients’ businesses from a whole--how does what we are doing on the media side fit into their goals? Their other initiatives?

• Still fun to work with, even though a data person ;)

Other Cool Things:
Be where you want to be, when you want to be there. We currently have team members living in the US, Canada, Spain, and Argentina. As long as you’re cool working roughly on Eastern Standard Time, you’re good to go.
Even though we aren’t in a physical office space, our team is close and connected. We collaborate daily through video calls and seek to create a fun, positive work environment. We also have team events around the world in which we physically come together to work, and play! You are encouraged to bring new ideas to the table daily, sharing information is key to our personal and business growth.
In addition to a salary of $50K to $75K, Rubato offers two weeks paid vacation annually plus an open policy on vacation requests.
If you are interested in this position, please apply! We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Post-doctorant.e : ANR ReCircle
description:
Unité : CERI Systèmes Numériques (CERI SN)
Responsable hiérarchique : Jean-Philippe VANDEBORRE, Directeur du CERI SN
Responsable fonctionnel : Mohammed-Amine ABDOUS, Maître de conférences, CERI SN
Catégorie : Post-doctorant(e) - chercheur contractuel ;
catégorie hiérarchique :
Nature de l’emploi : Contrat post-doctoral de droit public - CDD de 24 mois - Projet ANR ReCircle
Lieu de travail : IMT Nord Europe - Douai, site Lahure (déplacements ponctuels à Mines Saint-Étienne et à Clermont-Ferrand)
Contexte :
École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.
IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.
Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».
Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr
Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d’Enseignement, de Recherche et d’Innovation Systèmes Numériques (CERI SN) d’IMT Nord Europe. Le CERI SN mène des recherches en informatique, intelligence artificielle, systèmes multi-agents, recherche opérationnelle et aide à la décision, avec un fort ancrage applicatif dans l’industrie du futur, la logistique et les jumeaux numériques.
Missions :
Le/la post-doctorant(e) sera recruté(e) dans le cadre du projet ANR ReCircle (AAPG 2025, 2026-2030), porté par Mines Saint-Étienne (LIMOS), IMT Nord Europe (CERI SN) et l’Université Clermont Auvergne (LIMOS). The Data Center Build and Delivery team develops the infrastructure that supports OpenAI’s research and products. We work with engineering, construction partners and Operations to deliver safe, reliable facilities at scale. As our portfolio grows, consistent health, safety and environmental practices and clear performance measures help teams identify risks early and deliver sites that are ready to operate.

About the Role

We are looking for an HSE and Portfolio Performance Lead to strengthen health, safety and environmental oversight and performance management across our data center construction portfolio. You will help sites meet applicable OSHA standards and other HSE requirements, from construction through commissioning and handoff to Operations.

You will work across site teams, delivery partners and central functions to establish practical expectations, verify execution and turn portfolio data into action. This role combines hands-on HSE expertise with a portfolio view of contractor performance, risk and operational readiness.

- Provide clear portfolio updates and recommendations to leadership, surface decisions and resource needs early, and build consistent safety leadership across employees, developers, contractors and service providers.

Qualifications

- Substantial experience leading HSE programs for major construction or complex industrial projects, including oversight across multiple sites or workstreams and responsibility for contractor performance.

- Working knowledge of applicable OSHA construction and general-industry standards, with experience translating requirements into site controls and verifying implementation across construction, commissioning and operating interfaces.

- Practical understanding of data center or complex industrial hazards, including electrical safety, hazardous-energy control and high-risk construction activities.

- Demonstrated ability to build assurance, performance reporting and corrective-action programs and use leading and lagging indicators to improve outcomes.

title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
Over the last 10+ years, Ellevation Education has built a thriving business serving the administrators, teachers, and specialists who support English Learners. Today, nearly 2,000 school districts use our software to manage their EL programs. We are a successful, growing business with a real mission: helping English Learners achieve their highest aspirations.

Districts across the country rely on Ellevation for the daily workflows that keep those programs running and the student data behind every instructional decision, and we earn that trust through what we build. We’re building a platform that is secure by design and fast to work on, and engineering practices that let eight squads ship with confidence. Much of that is still unbuilt. We want leaders who study how we work today, find the gaps we haven’t seen yet, and then design and build the systems, practices, and team that close them.

Ellevation operates as part of Curriculum Associates (“CA”) which provides several shared functions across all of its business units, including a centralized security organization. Ellevation runs its own R&D organization including engineering, product, and design; CA supplies scanning, security tooling, reporting, and KPIs.

Ellevation R&D spans engineering, product, and design, organized into eight product squads. Each squad owns its product area end to end and moves quickly within it. The work that spans squads, such as platform modernization, authentication, dependency currency, and security, needs deliberate ownership to move at the same pace.

About The Role

This is a senior role in R&D, and its impact reaches everything Ellevation builds. You’ll see across all eight squads, spot the problems and opportunities that sit where their work meets, and make a case for which of them matter most to the business. Platform modernization, authentication, dependency health, and security are where that work starts today, and you’ll shape what comes next.

You’ll lead a team of Staff Engineers who drive critical parts of this work, making the case for where their time goes and making sure every initiative has a clear owner, a plan the squads can work with, and an agreed outcome. We expect to grow the team over time, and you’ll shape and lead that hiring.

Your impact scales through your team. Our Staff Engineers work across squads, partnering with engineering managers and product leads to move shared work forward within real squad capacity. You'll help them choose the right problems, sequence work across the organization, and grow as technical leaders. You'll stay close enough to the technical detail to judge tradeoffs and stand behind your team's decisions.

Security is a core part of this portfolio, and we want a leader with meaningful security experience to own it. You'll lead security practice at Ellevation, working with CA on the standards, SLAs, and KPIs we're measured against and making sure Ellevation meets them. You'll also be a key liaison to CA's central security organization.

You’ll be accountable for the results of this work. That means weighing what should be fixed now, what can wait, and what isn’t worth doing, then recommending a path and explaining why it matters for the business. Security findings, CA’s standards, and Ellevation’s product priorities all compete for the same R&D time, and you’ll make the case for how to balance them. That includes making CA’s scanning, tooling, and reporting work for how Ellevation builds software, and representing Ellevation in CA’s security forums.

Deciding what to take on each cycle is a decision made among R&D leaders, and you are one of them. You bring the picture of technical and security risk that shapes what the group decides, and you're in the room when it's decided. You report to the VP of Engineering, who is an active partner and will engage where it counts, but you're expected to move things forward on your own.

title: Principal Harness Engineer
description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO ) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
The Opportunity
Come join our engineering team in a hands-on technical role at the heart of a new discipline: Harness Engineering. As AI coding agents take on more of the software lifecycle, the hard part is no longer writing code - agents generate it faster than humans can review it, so the bottleneck shifts to verification and trust. Harness Engineering exists to break that bottleneck: engineering the environment that steers agents toward correct, maintainable, well-architected output so that quality is enforced by the system, not re-audited by a person on every change. We call that environment the harness (Agent = Model + Harness). As a Senior Harness Engineer you'll independently own whole harness subsystems, set the standards other engineers build to, and be involved in the end-to-end lifecycle of turning raw model capability into production-grade engineering.
What You’ll Contribute

• Design, build, deploy, and support core components of the harness - the guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that turn raw model capability into production-grade engineering. This is a hands-on role focused on systems and leverage, not hand-writing application code.

• Own and evolve feedforward guides - agent instruction files, reusable skills, architectural rules, reference docs, and codemods - and drive team-wide standardisation so agents get it right the first time.

• Build feedback sensors - custom linters, static analysis, structural and architecture-fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers - that catch issues automatically before they reach human reviewers.

• Own quality gating and release criteria for agent-produced work, defining authority boundaries for what agents may merge unaided and the escalation rules for what must route to a human.

• Establish LLM testing infrastructure and evaluation approaches that ensure AI-generated output meets quality and safety thresholds; apply consumer/contract testing (e.g. Pact) where service integration reliability matters.

• Run the steering loop - when an agent repeats a mistake, engineer a control so it can't happen again - and treat repository knowledge (docs, specs, context) as the system of record, fighting drift with continuous garbage collection.

• Decide where each control runs in the path to production - fast checks pre-commit, more expensive checks post-integration, and continuous sensors that scan for drift outside the change lifecycle - keeping quality as far left as is economical.

• Improve observability into agent work and track the measures that matter - cost per merged PR, time-to-merge for agent-assisted PRs, review velocity relative to PR size, defect escape rate, and agent-PR survival rate - using them to decide where to invest next.

• Partner with product and platform teams to turn specifications and acceptance criteria into enforceable controls.

• Serve as a source of technical expertise and mentor engineers across teams in harness practices and the effective, responsible use of AI tools.

What We’re Seeking

• Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science or related disciplines, or relevant commercial experience in software architecture, design, development, and testing.

• Seasoned software engineer with experience in large, complex codebases and a strong foundation in architecture and design; you care deeply about testing and maintainability.

• Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and a well-developed feel for where they succeed and fail.

• Proven ability to build engineering tooling across a modern stack - linters and static analysis, CI/CD pipelines, containerised build/test environments, and instrumentation/observability - plus familiarity with agent instruction conventions such as AGENTS.md.

title: Marketing Researcher (Part Time)
description:
About the Work

The founder has spent several years building a marketing framework that is becoming a book, a community office hours series, and a full curriculum. It also powers our software. Everything we teach and sell rests on evidence, so we are hiring a researcher to build and protect that foundation.

The Role

You will work directly with the founder to turn the framework into an education program that holds up to scrutiny, and to supply the research our software is built on. You find the strongest evidence, tell us what it does and does not support, and help shape what we teach.
The role starts with research and grows into curriculum and test building, and into using AI to create marketing assets. How fast it grows depends on how quickly you establish the foundation for the framework. The founder is preparing much of the material for you to take over.

What You Will Own

• The evidence library for the book, starting with the relationship marketing claims

• A research pass on every office hours outline: each claim checked section by section, newest research first, with a claims and sources list the founder reviews before anything is cited

• The curriculum structure: one core question and one takeaway for each chapter, learning objectives for each, and a path through the office hours topics

• Tests and assessments for the curriculum, including questions that check what learners understood

• Prompts and workflows that use AI to create marketing assets, built with the founder and checked against the evidence

• Behavioral science input on how buyers think and decide, which feeds the buyer psychology behind each session and each persona in our software

• Market research for new products, including target markets, buyer segments, and inputs to competitor discovery

• Short summaries of new academic and industry research that affect the framework

What You Bring

• A background in behavioral science, such as psychology, behavioral economics, or consumer decision-making

• Hands-on experience with research methods, both quantitative and qualitative

• Marketing experience, ideally in both B2B and B2C settings

• Strong judgment about which sources deserve trust, and the habit of checking the original study instead of a summary of it

• The ability to write findings in plain language that a business owner can use

• AI fluency: you write clear prompts, build repeatable workflows, and check what AI returns against the original sources

Nice to Have

• Experience building curriculum, training programs, assessments, or educational content

• Familiarity with positioning, brand strategy, or innovation research

How We Will Measure Success

• Week 2: an audit of the evidence library with every unsourced claim listed by chapter

• Day 45: gaps closed for the foundation chapters and a draft curriculum outline for the first level

• Day 90: the full curriculum outline and a research brief on the first target market

Hours and Pay

• Part time, 20 to 30 hours a week

• $40 per hour

How We Work

• You present findings first, and nothing gets cited in a public asset until the founder approves it

• Recent research leads, and older foundational work is included when it still holds

• The founder makes the final call on what the framework says

• You will work closely with the portfolio content marketer, who turns approved findings into messaging and sales assets

title: Regional Sales Manager (Automotive Software Sales)
description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
 
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?
 
 

The Ideal Candidate

From hunting new prospects to nurturing long-term partnerships, your role will span the full sales cycle. 

The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate a strong track record of sales achievement in a fast-paced environment. Excellent collaboration will be required across multi-function teams. This Senior Account Executive will have excellent interpersonal, relationship building skills, demonstrate resilience and be committed to a performance culture. A pro-active approach to continuous improvement and a ‘can do’ attitude is essential. 

Why join us?
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
 
An inclusive environment to thrive
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity.  We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
 
Be rewarded for your efforts
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
 
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
 
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.  We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
 
"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

description: We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed. Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift. title: Logistics Analyst II (Onsite)
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

The Logistics & Trade Specialist plays a critical role within Axon's Global Logistics team, ensuring compliant, efficient, and scalable international transportation operations. In this role, you will apply specialized expertise in international logistics, U.S. export controls, customs regulations, dangerous goods transportation, and air freight to execute daily shipments and navigate complex regulatory environments. As Axon continues its global expansion, this position offers significant opportunities to expand your technical expertise, drive process improvements, and advance your career within our growing Global Logistics organization.

What You’ll Do

Location: Onsite / Hybrid

Reports to: Logistics Manager

• Coordinate and execute international air freight, time-sensitive shipments, and complex transport activities.

• Partner with freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely delivery and compliance.

• Prepare, review, and validate international shipping and dangerous goods (DG) documentation against ITAR, EAR, IATA, and DOT regulations.

• Proactively track shipments and troubleshoot delays, customs holds, and operational exceptions.

• Support process improvement and automation initiatives for ERP-generated documentation and shipping workflows.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Distribution, Trade Compliance, Procurement, Sales Operations, and Manufacturing.

• Assist with reporting, shipment analysis, and transportation cost optimization.

What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience in international logistics, export compliance, customs, or dangerous goods transportation (or equivalent practical experience).

• Working knowledge of ITAR, EAR, customs processes, air freight operations, and DG transport regulations (IATA/DOT).

• Demonstrated track record coordinating international shipments with freight forwarders and customs brokers.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and cross-functional communication skills.

• Preferred: Relevant certifications (LCB, CES, CCS, DG/IATA) or experience with ERP systems (e.g., D365) and regulated industries.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.
Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Retail & E-commerce
description: Jij helpt retailers om AI echt onderdeel van hun dagelijkse operatie te maken. Duizenden producten, meerdere kanalen, wisselende vraag en klanten die snel antwoord verwachten. In retail en e-commerce liggen veel kansen voor AI, maar alleen als de oplossing aansluit op processen, systemen en mensen. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. </
